FIRST GAME

It starts with two trucks.

You have a city, factories and a small fuel supply. Start extraction, set up transport and deliver to the hub 12 iron, 6 copper and 8 asphalt.

  1. Choose a truck and the iron deposit. Deliver materials in several trips.
  2. Send builders separately. They return on the same truck after construction.
  3. Assign repeated hauling. Factories process raw materials automatically.
  4. Build a paved road or start with small off-road deliveries.

Pause stops all time. Take your time exploring options. Hints below the map help you get started.
